display.purpose: Playfair Display 900 at clamp(2.9rem,9.5vw,7.5rem), line-height 0.9, tracking -0.055em. Hero and page-opening headlines; one word often italic-medium, terminal period in gold.

headline.purpose: Playfair Display 600 at clamp(1.85rem,4.2vw,3rem). Section and booking-step titles.

accent.purpose: Montserrat ExtraBold uppercase at clamp(1.4rem,3.8vw,2.4rem). Service names only, in the client's exact words; warms to gold on hover.

body.purpose: Inter 400, line-height ~1.6; secondary copy at ink/50-60, max measure ~68ch.

label.purpose: Inter 500, 0.72rem, tracking 0.22em, uppercase. Overlines, field labels, image captions, status overlines (hero subhead rides wider at 0.42em).

shadows.name: gold-metal-lift
shadows.purpose: Resting shadow of the primary gold button — inset top highlight + soft gold cast so it reads as lit metal.

shadows.name: gold-metal-lift-hover
shadows.purpose: Primary button hover — deepened gold bloom with the lift.

shadows.name: gold-hover-bloom-row
shadows.purpose: Large soft gold glow under a service row on hover.

shadows.name: gold-hover-bloom-ghost
shadows.purpose: Soft gold glow under ghost/Call buttons on hover.

shadows.name: section-lift
shadows.purpose: The one neutral structural shadow (Tailwind token shadow-lift), for deeply lifted panels.

shadows.name: thread-node-glow
shadows.purpose: Gold halo on the scroll-progress node.

shadows.name: medallion-lift
shadows.purpose: Faint gold rim + lift on the crest medallion.

motion.name: house-spring
motion.purpose: The single house spring — slow, smooth, a gentle settle. Drives fadeUp lifts and the section Reveal; never a cartoon bounce.

motion.name: ease-luxe
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out — the house curve for fades, clip reveals, color/theme transitions, and all hover timing.

motion.name: theme-flip
motion.purpose: Low-specificity transition of background/border/color/fill/stroke when the theme toggles.

motion.name: service-sweep
motion.purpose: One-pass diagonal gold gleam across a service row on hover.

motion.name: lenis-scroll
motion.purpose: Inertial smooth scrolling; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

atmosphere.name: aura
atmosphere.value: two screen-blended radial-gold blobs (rgba(212,175,55,0.14/0.10)), blur 60px, opacity 0.55, drifting 26s/34s
atmosphere.purpose: The single sanctioned ambient gold field — depth in the obsidian ground, not decoration.

atmosphere.name: grain
atmosphere.value: fixed fractalNoise SVG veil, opacity 0.075, mix-blend overlay, 0.7s stepped shift
atmosphere.purpose: Filmic grain so obsidian never reads as a flat digital void.

atmosphere.name: placeholder-sheen
atmosphere.value: 115deg gold/white linear sweep, background-size 250%, 5s ease-in-out loop
atmosphere.purpose: Slow diagonal sheen across branded image placeholders.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The gold metal CTA — used for Book Now and booking Continue/Confirm.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 14px 28px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.015em; color: #0A0A0A; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #E7CC6E 0%, #D4AF37 55%, #BF9C2E 100%); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35) inset, 0 10px 30px -12px rgba(212,175,55,0.5); transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.035); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5) inset, 0 24px 55px -12px rgba(212,175,55,0.78); } .ds-btn-gold:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-gold:disabled { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); box-shadow: none; transform: none; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — hairline outline warming to gold. Call Salon, Back to site.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 14px 28px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.015em; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22); transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.7); color: #FFFFFF; background: rgba(212,175,55,0.06); }

components.name: Style Chip
components.description: Optional per-service style selector in the booking flow; selected fills solid gold.
components.css: .ds-chip { border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.6); color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-chip--on { background: #D4AF37; color: #0A0A0A; border-color: #D4AF37; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Selectable service card in booking step 1; border warms to gold, fills faint gold when picked.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; background: #121212; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.5); } .ds-card--on { border-color: #D4AF37; background: rgba(212,175,55,0.06); } .ds-card__name { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-card__price { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; color: #D4AF37; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Booking detail field — surface fill, hairline border shifting to gold on focus, gold caret.
components.css: .ds-field__label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); } .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; background: #121212; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); caret-color: #D4AF37; transition: border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.7); outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D4AF37; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Desktop nav link — gold underline wipes in left-to-right on hover.
components.css: .ds-navlink { position: relative; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-navlink:hover { color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-navlink::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -0.375rem; height: 1px; width: 0; background: #D4AF37; transition: width 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-navlink:hover::after { width: 100%; }

components.name: Service Row
components.description: Signature editorial menu row — poster-caps name + gold price over a hairline divider, with a gold gleam sweep on hover.
components.html:
BRAID EXTENSIONS

Neat, long-lasting braid extensions.

from £90
components.css: .ds-row { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); padding: 2rem 1rem; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-row:hover { transform: scale(1.012); background: rgba(212,175,55,0.04); box-shadow: 0 26px 70px -30px rgba(212,175,55,0.6); } .ds-row__main { min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-row__name { font-family: Montserrat, Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-size: clamp(1.4rem,3.8vw,2.4rem); color: #FFFFFF; transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row__name { color: #D4AF37; } .ds-row__copy { margin-top: 0.625rem; font-size: 0.95rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); } .ds-row__price { flex-shrink: 0; font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; color: #D4AF37; } .ds-row__arrow { height: 1.5rem; width: 1.5rem; flex-shrink: 0; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-row:hover .ds-row__arrow { transform: translate(0.25rem,-0.25rem); color: #D4AF37; } .ds-row__gleam { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; mix-blend-mode: screen; background: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 40%, rgba(212,175,55,0.12) 47%, rgba(255,255,255,0.16) 50%, rgba(212,175,55,0.12) 53%, transparent 60%); background-size: 250% 100%; background-position: 150% 0; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row__gleam { opacity: 1; animation: ds-sweep 0.85s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } @keyframes ds-sweep { from { background-position: 150% 0; } to { background-position: -60% 0; } }

components.name: Branded Image Placeholder
components.description: Signature photography stand-in — obsidian panel with gold medallion, hairline weave, sheen sweep and inset frame.
components.css: .ds-placeholder { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #0A0A0A; min-height: 240px; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-placeholder__bloom { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(212,175,55,0.07), transparent 68%); } .ds-placeholder__weave { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0.5; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.016) 0, rgba(255,255,255,0.016) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 9px); } .ds-placeholder__mark { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-placeholder__frame { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }

narrative.overview: VAULT 876 is a hair and beauty salon rendered as a luxury fashion house. The system treats a near-empty matte-obsidian ground as the primary material and negative space as the real luxury — the way a Vogue cover or a Celine campaign lets one confident gesture carry the page. Onto that quiet dark it lays crisp white type, a single precious metal (gold), and a warm high-contrast serif, then warms the restraint with cultural swagger: poster-weight uppercase service names, a slow gold gleam, a drifting ambient aura. The register is 'Apple makes a Black urban hair and beauty salon' — editorial elegance plus Apple-grade smoothness plus unapologetic confidence. The surface is deliberately atmospheric rather than flat-digital: a fixed filmic grain veil, a faint screen-blended gold aura that drifts behind everything, and branded medallion panels that stand in for photography. Density is low and rhythmic — large type, generous gutters, hairline gold/white dividers doing the structural work instead of boxes and fills. Motion is the connective tissue: one house spring and one exponential ease-out curve carry every reveal. The one thing the world refuses is the category default: the cluttered promo flyer, the service laundry-list, same-size icon cards, and above all the incumbent's hot-pink accent. Pink is banned outright. Gold is rationed. The brand must read premium before it reads 'salon'.
keyCharacteristics: Matte-obsidian ground (#0A0A0A) held nearly empty; negative space is the primary material.
A single precious metal — gold (#D4AF37) — on actions, hairlines, and active states only.
Editorial type contrast: Playfair Display serif + Montserrat ExtraBold poster caps + Inter UI.
One house motion identity (a spring + an ease-out curve) across every surface.
Branded medallion placeholders instead of stock photography; no human faces.
Dark by default, with an optional light theme; gold holds unchanged in both.

rules.name: The One Metal Rule
rules.body: Gold stays precise on UI — primary actions, hairline accents, active states — and is never poured as a glow or gradient wash across chrome or content. The single sanctioned exception is one faint, slow-drifting, screen-blended ambient aura in the obsidian ground. The primary action button is the second deliberate exception: it is rendered as actual metal, because gold is the brand's material.

rules.name: The No-Pink Rule
rules.body: No pink, ever, in any tint or state. The incumbent's hot-pink accent is the specific thing this identity removes; a pink value anywhere is a brand defect, not a variation.

rules.name: The Semantic-Invert Rule
rules.body: canvas, ink, and surface are theme-aware tokens (CSS vars) that invert between the default dark theme and the optional light theme. Gold and its two edges do not invert.

rules.name: The Client's-Words Rule
rules.body: Service names render in the salon's exact flyer terminology. Never creatively rewrite a service name, even for consistency.

rules.name: The Overline-Not-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Wide-tracked uppercase caps are a label/caption voice — field labels, image overlines, status overlines — not a decorative eyebrow stacked above a headline.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Drop Rule
rules.body: Elevation on interactive elements is expressed as a soft gold bloom that responds to hover/active, not as a neutral grey drop shadow and never as a hard offset shadow.

dos: Do keep gold rationed — primary actions, hairline accents, active/selected states, and the one sanctioned ambient aura. Render the primary button as actual metal (the gold gradient + lift).
Do hold the obsidian ground nearly empty; let negative space and hairline dividers carry structure instead of boxes and fills.

Do carry the house motion identity everywhere: the spring (stiffness 52, damping 15, mass 1.05) for lifts and the ease-out curve cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) for fades/clip/color — slow, smooth, never a cartoon bounce. Honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do set service names in Montserrat ExtraBold uppercase using the client's exact words, with Playfair for display and Inter for UI.
Do use the branded medallion placeholder for any empty image slot; keep imagery face-free until the salon's own shoot lands.
Do express interactive depth as a soft gold bloom responding to hover/active.
donts: Don't use pink in any tint, state, or gradient — anywhere.
Don't pour gold as a glow or gradient wash across chrome or content; only the ambient aura and the metal button are sanctioned gold fields.
Don't use neutral grey drop shadows or hard offset shadows for structure; surfaces are flat at rest and lit gold on interaction.
Don't render the menu as a grid of same-size icon cards or a plain laundry-list — it is an editorial hairline row-list.
Don't stack an invented uppercase kicker/eyebrow above a headline; the tracked caps are a label/caption voice only.
Don't ship a dead primary button; disabled state must read plainly inert, and every CTA must be live (book or call).
